Матчи проходят по круговой системе. За каждую сыгранную карту каждый участник получает $20 за победу и $10 за поражение.

По итогам сезона два лучших капитана выходят в финал Best of 5.

Общий призовой фонд турнира — $87 000.

Новости и результаты турнира: https://t.me/supermixercup

tournaments.description:
Virtual Sports League (VSL) is an Australian based company. Currently organising and running competitive online E-Sporting leagues.

Official League Format  
- Play 1 match per week against another team.  
- Earn Ladder points for wins (3 pts) Loss (1pt)  
- Earn bonus points for meeting specific in-game objectives (1 pt). 

At the end of the regular season, top teams battle it out in knockout finals.  Many league matches are casted/streamed live. The grand final is BO3, which is casted by VSL authorised casters. -- Watch live at https://www.youtube.com/@virtualsportsleague/live

Info at Discord to see if It's for you: https://discord.gg/YQDAQ26X68

raw.name: The PwR Inhouse - Balanced Shuffle Flex
raw.description:
The PwR Gaming Club's inhouse ticket tracking all games under the Flex ruleset, where the teams were created via balanced shuffle.

Flex rules means try your hardest (flex on your friends) - and if you do poorly people might just think you're bad at dota!

Balanced Shuffle is Valve's team balance algorithm, which depends on their account being accurately calibrated.

tournaments.name: FACEIT
tournaments.description: FACEIT is the leading independent competitive gaming platform for online multiplayer PvP games with more than thirty million users players worldwide. We aim to further the esports ecosystem by offering players of all levels the chance to compete in a competitive environment with the games they love while providing publishers and third-party organizers with the tools needed to build their competitive community.
